principle: Measure the symptom before changing configuration.
safe_modern_form: Record what fails, when it fails, recent changes, and one reproducible baseline. Change one variable at a time.
verification: The symptom and the test conditions can be reproduced and compared before and after the change.
risk_notes: Avoid registry edits, firmware changes, or destructive repair based only on a vague speed complaint.

principle: Back up important data before repair, reinstall, or hardware work.
safe_modern_form: Identify valuable data, make a second copy on separate storage, and open a sample of the copy before proceeding.
verification: A test file restores successfully and the backup date and location are recorded.
risk_notes: A backup that has never been tested is an assumption, not a recovery plan.

principle: Stop writing to a drive when deleted data may need recovery.
safe_modern_form: Power down or isolate the affected volume, work from a separate system or image, and use a documented recovery workflow.
verification: The recovery process reads from a copy or image and does not modify the source.
risk_notes: Installing recovery software on the affected drive can overwrite recoverable data.
source_themes: file recovery after deletion or formatting

principle: Compatibility matters more than isolated component rankings.
safe_modern_form: Check socket or platform, memory type, firmware support, physical clearance, power connectors, storage interfaces, and case dimensions as a set.
verification: Every selected part has a documented compatibility path and no connector or clearance conflict remains.
risk_notes: Old part names, benchmark tables, and forum recommendations are version-bound.

principle: Heat and airflow are reliability concerns, not only performance concerns.
safe_modern_form: Keep vents clear, monitor temperatures under a repeatable workload, and clean only after shutdown, unplugging, cooling, and ESD preparation.
verification: Temperature and noise measurements improve or remain within the component maker's current limits.
risk_notes: Do not use liquids inside a powered computer or force fans, coolers, or connectors.

principle: Use a stop condition when physical work becomes uncertain.
safe_modern_form: Consult the current component manual and stop if a part does not fit, a cable label is unclear, or force is required.
verification: The part is installed without bent pins, damaged clips, stripped screws, or unexplained leftover cables.
risk_notes: Physical force can turn a reversible maintenance task into permanent damage.

principle: Separate historical instructions from supported recovery paths.
safe_modern_form: Identify the current OS and use its supported recovery media, update channel, diagnostic tools, and documented reset options.
verification: The recovery media and installed OS version are identified before any reset or reinstall begins.
risk_notes: Windows XP paths, old Registry locations, and unknown download links must not be presented as universal steps.

principle: Troubleshoot from the physical link upward.
safe_modern_form: Check power and cables, link state, local address, gateway, DNS, and service reachability in that order, keeping tests limited to systems you own or administer.
verification: The failing layer is isolated by a local test and a documented expected result.
risk_notes: Traffic tests against third-party systems can become disruptive or unauthorized.

principle: Historical attack instructions are more useful as defensive indicators than as procedures.
safe_modern_form: Extract behaviors, artifacts, and affected assumptions; convert them into detection, patching, isolation, account recovery, and authorized lab exercises.
verification: The output explains how to detect or recover without providing a reusable attack recipe.
risk_notes: Do not include credential theft, malware construction, denial of service, bypasses, or unauthorized access steps.

principle: Old troubleshooting archives may expose sensitive identifiers.
safe_modern_form: Redact passwords, IP addresses, license keys, email addresses, private URLs, and personal names before indexing or publishing.
verification: A secret and identifier scan finds no raw credentials or direct personal identifiers in the release.
risk_notes: A small text file can still contain enough information to harm a person or system.

principle: Prefer maintained official tools over mirrors and abandoned downloads.
safe_modern_form: Use the vendor or standards source, verify release and platform support, and record the access date.
verification: The tool source, version, checksum or signature where appropriate, and supported platform are documented.
risk_notes: Do not recommend cracks, keygens, pirated media, or unknown executables.

principle: A media workflow is defined by input, target, codec, subtitles, and validation.
safe_modern_form: State the legal input, target device or platform, output format, quality goal, and playback test before choosing a current tool.
verification: The output plays on the target and the important audio, subtitle, and metadata checks pass.
risk_notes: Historical optical-disc steps and codecs are often obsolete and may implicate copyright.

principle: Small playable loops teach more reliably than a large feature list.
safe_modern_form: Start with a player, input, one obstacle, one goal, feedback, and restart; add one tested feature at a time.
verification: A new learner can run the prototype, trigger the win condition, and restart it.
risk_notes: Historical engine UI and project files may not open in current versions.

principle: Repeatable edits and export checks are more durable than menu paths.
safe_modern_form: Preserve the original, describe layers or transformations by intent, and validate dimensions, color, transparency, and output format.
verification: The exported asset matches the target specification and the original remains recoverable.
risk_notes: Old Photoshop menus and plugin names are version-bound.

principle: A useful runbook states prerequisites, expected results, verification, and rollback.
safe_modern_form: Write each step as an action plus an observable result, then add a safe undo or recovery path.
verification: A reader can tell whether each step worked and what to do when it did not.
risk_notes: Confident prose without evidence or stop conditions turns obsolete advice into operational risk.

principle: Preserve source boundaries and label uncertainty instead of blending claims into a false consensus.
safe_modern_form: Track source filename, claim, status, risk, evidence needed, and modern recommendation in a claim ledger.
verification: Every published recommendation can be traced to a source theme or clearly marked new guidance.
risk_notes: Do not copy source prose wholesale or imply that an unverified forum claim is authoritative.
